claims.text: USCRN's instruments are calibrated and maintained by NOAA ARL's Atmospheric Turbulence and Diffusion Division (ATDD, Oak Ridge): a team of eight technicians and engineers makes an annual visit to each of the 141 stations, swaps one of the three platinum resistance thermometers and calibrates the rain gauges; the thermometers are traceable to NIST. [DIRS-1 supports]

NCEI manages and maintains USCRN station observations, and NOAA’s Atmospheric Turbulence and Diffusion Division (ATDD) maintains instrumentation and field sites in a long term partnership with NCEI.
When each site is deployed, all of the sensors are calibrated and put on a maintenance plan that includes routine replacement of aging sensors and annual maintenance visits.
therm om eters (PRT) which have demonstrated | excellent performance over the last 12 m onths and | are tra cea ble to National Institute of Standards and | Technology calibration.
